# My Profile

Your details are in four files, by how often each changes: this one (who you are), `training.md` (kits, likes and dislikes, your usual session), `content.md` (interests, feeds and taste, for the stories) and `settings.toml` (delivery, audio and setup). Injuries are in `health.md`, and the workout log and feedback in `log.md`.

I listen to narrated workouts through earbuds, with no screen and no timer. The audio is the workout: it tells me what to do, keeps me company, and moves me along on time. Priorities, in order: safe for my body today, clean to the ear, worth listening to.

## Basics
- Name or nickname (optional): Sam (invented)
- Neighborhood: Testville (an invented town)
- Training background and current fitness:
- Goals right now:
## Listening setup
- Earbuds, one times speed. The MP3 that `./harmonicfitness build` renders is the workout.
- Delivery wanted: a coach or instructor, grounded and motivating. Not an announcer, not sleepy, not goofy or high-pitched.
## Narrator
How the coach talks now lives with each coach, in me/personas/<coach>/persona.md.
